title: L'Hopital's Rule: ∞/∞ Form
description: The ∞/∞ indeterminate form of L'Hopital's rule: if g(x) → +∞ and f'(x)/g'(x) → c, then f(x)/g(x) → c. Not in Mathlib as of v4.26.

meta.assumptions: 3 axioms: lhopital_infty_right (right limit), lhopital_infty_left (left limit), lhopital_infty_atTop (limit at +∞). All state the ∞/∞ form of L'Hopital. Provable from Cauchy MVT.

sections.title: ∞/∞ L'Hopital Variants
sections.summary: Three variants of L'Hopital's rule for the ∞/∞ form: right limit (x → a⁺), left limit (x → b⁻), and at infinity (x → +∞). Axiomatized with proof sketches via CMVT.

sections.title: Growth Rate Comparison
sections.summary: Proves that if f/g → 0 and g → +∞, then eventually f < g. A direct application of ratio limit philosophy.

overview.text: The ∞/∞ indeterminate form of L'Hopital's rule: if g(x) → +∞ and f'(x)/g'(x) → c, then f(x)/g(x) → c.
overview.proofStrategy: The ∞/∞ form follows from the Cauchy Mean Value Theorem. The key trick: write f(x)/g(x) as a CMVT ratio times a correction that tends to 1, plus a remainder that tends to 0.

conclusion.summary: States the ∞/∞ L'Hopital rule in three variants, with one proved corollary on growth comparison. The axioms are provable from Cauchy MVT but require careful ε-δ formalization.
